svg.title: The Gorge challenge course
svg.desc: North-up map of the Columbia River between Stevenson and Bingen, passing Hood River. The challenge begins at Bingen, heads downstream toward Stevenson, and returns upstream. Washington lies north of the river and Oregon south.

g.text: The Gorge challenge: Bingen → Stevenson → Bingen
Shared tracks overlap: solid outbound · dashed return
Gate references and route: NOAA ENC · Gate offsets: BlueDog::Mission::Course model
Water extent: NOAA ENC depth-area polygons · Reference paths, not simulated sailing tracks
